//go:build integration

package integration

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	privateapi "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private"
	privatehandlers "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// Named owner metadata fixtures only. Root starts this finite registered HTTP/PG
// provider; final Evidence ingestion is proved separately in T20.5.
func TestT201HybridSnapshotOwnerProvider(t *testing.T) {
	ready := os.Getenv("T201_OWNER_READY_FILE")
	if ready == "" {
		t.Skip("root-only owner provider not requested")
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(os.Getenv("STUDENT_PLANNING_SNAPSHOT_TEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil || cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58999 || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t201_student_integration_proof" || cfg.ConnConfig.User != "postgres" || cfg.ConnConfig.TLSConfig != nil {
		t.Fatal("exact isolated native owner proof required")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	f := t201SnapshotFixture(t, ctx, pool)
	h := &privatehandlers.Handler{PlanningSnapshot: studentuc.GetPlanningSnapshot{Reader: &postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}}}
	r := chi.NewRouter()
	r.Mount("/internal", privateapi.NewRouter(h, "t201-owner-general-fixture", "t201-owner-planner-fixture"))
	server := httptest.NewServer(r)
	defer server.Close()
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"url": server.URL, "student_id": f.path.StudentID, "path_id": f.path.ID, "targets": f.targets, "token": "t201-owner-planner-fixture"})
	if err := os.WriteFile(ready, raw, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ticker := time.NewTicker(100 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatal("owner proof timed out")
		case <-ticker.C:
			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Clean(ready) + ".stop"); err == nil {
				return
			}
		}
	}
}
